payload.title: Set up PostgreSQL schema + migrations
payload.detail: Create initial tables: users, todos, sessions. Use golang-migrate. Seed dev data.
payload.done_summary: Schema created with 3 tables, 2 migrations, dev seed script. golang-migrate integrated into Makefile.

payload.title: Implement JWT auth middleware
payload.detail: Parse and validate access token on protected routes. Return 401 on invalid/expired token.
payload.done_summary: Middleware validates RS256 JWT. Unit tests cover expired, malformed, and valid tokens.

payload.title: CRUD endpoints: /todos
payload.detail: GET /todos (paginated), POST /todos, PUT /todos/:id, DELETE /todos/:id. All require auth.

payload.title: Rate limiter middleware
payload.detail: Implement sliding window rate limiter. 5 req/min for /auth/login, 100 req/min for API.

payload.title: Integration test suite with testcontainers
payload.detail: Boot Postgres container in TestMain, run migrations, seed fixture data. Cover happy path + edge cases.

payload.title: OpenAPI spec (swagger.yaml)
payload.detail: Document all endpoints with request/response schemas. Use swaggo or hand-write.

payload.title: CI pipeline: lint + test + build
payload.detail: GitHub Actions workflow. Run golangci-lint, go test ./..., docker build on every PR.
